_comment: 'baseline' lists the axe rule ids that fire on the page today, each with the
reason it is tolerated. The spec asserts the found set EQUALS the baseline, so
a NEW violation fails the test and a violation that has been FIXED also fails
it -- which forces the entry to be deleted rather than left to accumulate.
A case is reached EITHER by 'path' -- a standing URL -- OR by 'category' and
'product', which the spec opens through the catalogue. The product page takes
the second form: /prod.html?idp_=<id> names a product by database key, which

baseline.image-alt: 2 nodes. Carousel and product-card images ship with no alternative text. Pre-existing on the public demo.

baseline.color-contrast: 1 node. Muted text does not reach the 4.5:1 contrast minimum.
baseline.image-alt: 2 nodes. Product imagery ships with no alternative text.
baseline.link-name: 2 nodes. The carousel's previous/next controls are icon-only links with no discernible name.

baseline.color-contrast: 1 node. Muted text does not reach the 4.5:1 contrast minimum.
baseline.image-alt: 2 nodes. Brand and cart imagery ship with no alternative text.
